text.tspan: Correct. The initial state is the point at the bottom of the vertical line. An increase of pressure at constant
volume is a vertical line with an upward arrowhead, an isothermal expansion is a curve to the right and
downward, a compression at constant pressure is a horizontal line to the left, and an isothermal
compression is a curve upward and to the left.
A sample of gas is in a container of fixed volume. The pressure of the gas is measured as its absolute temperature is
increased. A graph of pressure measurements as a function of temperature is shown above. The sample of gas is
transferred to a second container with half the volume of the first container, and the experiment is repeated.
According to the ideal gas law, which of the following will be true of the best-fit line for the new data compared to
the best-fit line for the data shown?
